_comment: Copy to config/codex-projects.json (gitignored) to use. Project-level overrides for Codex, mirroring projects.example.json. Codex keys a project by the working directory recorded in its rollout files, so renaming or moving a folder starts a brand-new project and splits its history. Use `merge` to stitch those back together, and `displayNames` to override the label. Every key starting with `_` is documentation and is ignored.

merge._comment: "<source project id>": "<target project id>" - the source's sessions, tokens, cost and runtime are folded into the target. Ids are the slugified working directory: C:\Users\you\Projects\Old Name becomes C--Users-you-Projects-Old-Name. Chains are followed (A->B->C all land on C); a cycle is ignored and logged as a warning.

displayNames._comment: "<project id>": "<label>" - overrides the name shown in the UI, which otherwise comes from the last segment of the working directory.
